purpose: Test whether baryonic component-vector disagreement becomes cluster-selective only when it persists over a finite universal coherence length.
field_equation: laplacian(Phi)=div[(nu I + lambda S C_cancel F(ell/Lc,q) h_hat h_hat) grad(Phi_N)]

definitions.ell: |g_N|/||grad g_N||_F along the baryon-only Newtonian field
definitions.primary_Lc_provenance: The 10 kpc scale was the best opened-data length in P0629 and is reused before P0643 scores; it is not selected from P0633/P0640 targets.

selection_rule: The primary Lc=10 kpc, q=1 row advances only if every primary gate passes. Sensitivity rows describe identifiability and are not allowed to replace a failed primary after scores are seen.
claim_boundary: A passing scale-separation screen would justify a spent-lensing ablation, not establish a gravity law.
Lc is a new universal dimensional constant. Its physical origin is unknown and must eventually be derived rather than merely fit.
The calculation remains projected and non-relativistic; it does not yet predict the relation between matter and photon metric potentials.
No P0633 velocity or P0640 multiple-image outcome may be opened in P0643.
